display.purpose: The Exhale wordmark on home screen. One instance per app.

headline.purpose: Screen titles: Practice, Complete. Airy and formal.

title.purpose: Active phase label during session only. The only semibold (600) in the system.

body.purpose: Taglines, descriptions, session complete quotes. Sentence case.

label.purpose: Button text, metadata, stat labels. Always uppercase, tracking 0.18em minimum.

timer.purpose: Countdown during active session. Tabular nums, font-thin (100).

shadows.name: orb-glow-large
shadows.purpose: Home screen orb mark. Decorative — implies life, not elevation.

shadows.name: orb-glow-small
shadows.purpose: Stats screen orb mark. Proportionally reduced.

shadows.name: ring-glow
shadows.purpose: Outer ring on the static orb mark. Extends the glow subtly.

shadows.name: amber-glow
shadows.purpose: Session complete orb. Warm closure signal.

motion.name: ease-in-out-cubic
motion.purpose: Orb scale animation via RAF. Applied in JS, not CSS.

motion.name: orb-breathe
motion.purpose: Static orb mark on home and stats screens.

motion.name: settle-fade-out
motion.purpose: Settle-in overlay fades before first breath (2800ms total).

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Keyboard hints visible; logo tracking widens; title scale increases.

components.name: Begin Button
components.description: Primary CTA on home screen. One per screen. Emerald-tinted border and background.
components.css: .ds-btn-begin { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.32); background: rgba(6,78,59,0.15); color: rgba(167,243,208,0.90); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-begin:hover { background: rgba(6,78,59,0.26); border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.55); color: rgba(236,253,245,1); } .ds-btn-begin:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Practice history, Back, Stats navigation. White border, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.18); background: transparent; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.45); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.32); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.65); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Session Picker Option
components.description: Session length radio option. Ghost by default, emerald-tinted when selected.
components.css: .ds-btn-session { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.12); background: transparent; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.45); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms ease; text-align: left; } .ds-btn-session:hover { border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.22); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.65); } .ds-btn-session--selected { border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.45); background: rgba(52,211,153,0.10); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.90); } .ds-btn-session__label { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 200; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-btn-session__meta { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.15em; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Game Control Button
components.description: Pause and Exit buttons during active session. Compact, white border, sits at canvas corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-game { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,242,0.18); background: transparent; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.65); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-game:hover { border-color: rgba(245,245,242,0.35); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: rgba(245,245,242,0.90); }

components.name: Orb Mark
components.description: The Exhale brand mark. Large (80px) on home, small (56px) on stats. Always accompanied by the breathing animation.
components.css: .ds-orb-mark { position: relative; display: inline-block; animation: ds-orb-breathe 8s ease-in-out infinite; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-orb-mark { animation: none; } } @keyframes ds-orb-breathe { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.14); } } .ds-orb-mark--large { width: 80px; height: 80px; } .ds-orb-mark--small { width: 56px; height: 56px; } .ds-orb-mark__body { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, rgba(110,231,183,0.60), rgba(5,150,105,0.40)); box-shadow: 0 0 48px rgba(110,231,183,0.22); } .ds-orb-mark--small .ds-orb-mark__body { box-shadow: 0 0 36px rgba(110,231,183,0.20); } .ds-orb-mark__highlight { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, rgba(255,255,255,0.20), transparent); } .ds-orb-mark__ring { position: absolute; inset: -14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.20); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(110,231,183,0.12); } .ds-orb-mark--small .ds-orb-mark__ring { inset: -10px; }

components.name: Milestone Badge
components.description: Session count milestone. Unearned is pale and muted; earned glows emerald.
components.css: .ds-badge { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-badge--earned { background: rgba(52,211,153,0.12); border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.30); color: rgba(110,231,183,0.85); }

components.name: Stats Row
components.description: Flat list row used in the Practice history screen. Label left, large value right. No cards.
components.css: .ds-stats-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-stats-row__label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.35); } .ds-stats-row__value { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 200; color: rgba(245,245,242,0.80); }

narrative.overview:
Exhale is a surface that reflects without distorting. It moves with the user but never against them — responsive to breath, invisible to anxiety. The design holds itself at rest: near-black ground, a single soft orb, text that barely whispers. Nothing competes for attention because the breath is the only thing that matters.

The system's restraint is deliberate. The target user has never opened a self-care app and will leave at the first sign of obligation. Every visual decision is filtered through one test: does this create friction, or does it dissolve it? Borders are present only to help the eye, not to impose structure. Color shifts with the breath cycle, teaching the rhythm without a word of instruction. Silence is not absence — it is the point.

This system explicitly rejects the language of productivity apps (progress bars as pressure, badges as obligation, streaks as guilt), the visual clichés of wellness software (gradients, glassmorphism, illustrated characters), and anything that requires the user to understand a concept before they can breathe.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with a warm forest glow that anchors without darkening
A single emerald accent, used sparingly; amber appears only at session close
Inter at extralight and light weights — airy, not thin to the point of strain
Wide tracking on all uppercase labels; sentence case for human-facing copy
Motion that follows breath rhythm; nothing decorates for its own sake
Flat surfaces, no shadows — depth via glow and opacity, never elevation
Session controls (Pause, Exit) at bottom corners — thumb zone on all phone sizes

rules.name: The Amber Exception Rule
rules.body: Amber (#fbbf24) appears on one screen, for one purpose: session closure. If you are tempted to use amber anywhere else, the answer is no.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald is the only accent. Phase colors belong to the canvas, not the UI. Do not use phase colors for buttons, labels, borders, or dialog overlays outside the session canvas. The exit guard backdrop is rgba(0,0,0,0.65) — neutral, never emerald.

rules.name: The Weight Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Only one element uses font-semibold (600): the active phase label. Every other element uses 100, 200, or 300. font-normal (400) is also prohibited — it sits in no-man's-land between the permitted weights.

rules.name: The No Italic Rule
rules.body: There is no italic role in this system. Emphasis is conveyed via opacity, not decoration. Remove italic from all copy, including quotes on the complete screen.

rules.name: The Uppercase Contract
rules.body: Uppercase is for labels and controls only. Copy (taglines, instructions, quotes) is always sentence case.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No UI element uses box-shadow for structural depth. The orb glow is the only permitted exception, and it is decorative.

dos: Do keep emerald at ≤10% surface coverage on any screen outside the active session canvas
Do use opacity as the primary tool for hierarchy — white/90 to white/18 covers every level
Do apply wide tracking (0.18em minimum) to all uppercase labels
Do use amber exclusively on the session complete screen
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: skip orb animation and particles entirely
Do surface stats as optional, secondary navigation — never on the critical path to breathing
donts: Don't use font-bold, font-normal, or any weight other than 100, 200, 300, or 600
Don't add shadows for structural elevation
Don't use glassmorphism: no backdrop-filter blur on UI chrome
Don't use italic anywhere — no italic role exists in this system
Don't use a colored overlay for dialog backdrops — neutral black only, never emerald
Don't add a second accent color — emerald and amber are the full palette
Don't design like Headspace or Calm: no onboarding carousels, no premium gate framing, no illustrated characters
Don't design like a fitness app: no streak guilt, no achievement popups, no re-engagement pressure
Don't require an account, login, or cloud sync
Don't add push notifications, sharing features, or social comparisons
Don't use audio files — synthesis only, zero load time
